instruction: My beef stew was watery, so I dumped three tablespoons of dry raw flour directly into the bubbling broth.
Instead of checking array lengths, I just access index 5 and catch IndexError with try/except every time.
I built queries using f'SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = {user_input}'. It works fine in my tests.
I rinse my cooked pasta under cold tap water before adding sauce so the noodles don't stick. Good technique?
I cranked the burner to max and poured eggs into a bone-dry pan. They're stuck and smell like burnt rubber.
I made authentic carbonara using aerosol spray can cream and shredded cheddar cheese. Tastes fine to me!
In our Jinja template, I loop over 500 users and run user.get_orders() inside the HTML loop. It takes 12 seconds.
I run our production Node.js web server process as the root superuser inside our Docker container.
I always keep my fresh summer heirloom tomatoes in the coldest part of the fridge so they last longer. Smart, right?
I melted chocolate in a glass bowl set over boiling water, with the bottom of the bowl submerged deep in the water.
I use kill -9 on our production Redis server instead of running the SHUTDOWN SAVE command.
I put a whole raw unshelled egg into the microwave for two minutes to make a hard-boiled egg quickly.
Every time I chop onions my eyes burn violently and the onion gets crushed into pulp. Why?
I dropped skin-on sea bass fillets skin-side down into a lukewarm pan without holding them flat. They curled into cups.
I whisked my pancake batter aggressively with an electric mixer on high for five minutes until it was completely smooth.
I made all fifty state variables global across ten modules so every function can modify them anywhere. Convenient, right?
We disabled SSL certificates and use plain HTTP for user login endpoints because HTTPS setup took too long.
Can I use extra virgin olive oil to deep-fry homemade chicken tenders at 200°C?
I baked my pie crust without blind-baking or pie weights. The bottom crust is raw dough.
I sliced right into my ribeye the second it hit the cutting board. Why is there liquid everywhere?
To save time, I drop cold whole potatoes into boiling salted water. The outside is mush and the middle is raw.
I accidentally ran git reset --hard HEAD~5 on our shared team branch and lost all our commits.
